items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: What instrument did you play with Don's band? ... Alto type.

ctx.x: Yeah, March 20th, 1907. Watch it. Okay, well. That's it.
He must have been a child when he was playing with Don. Wait a minute. Wait a minute. Okay. Well, I'll ask Robert.
I don't think Robert can remember that far back.
